concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-rakutenpay]] — 2026-09-15 Rakuten Pay JP/JPY redirect-wallet overview for Ecommerce/IPP and channel routes; positive capability marks repeatedly say “See note” without an explanatory note in the pinned page, so their conditions remain unresolved.
warnings: The matrix's “See note” qualifiers have no corresponding explanatory note in this pinned page; do not promote positive marks as unqualified operational guarantees.
The overview says Ecommerce and IPP but does not define IPP or supply merchant/entity eligibility requirements.
Shopper return and capability marks do not establish successful authorization, capture, settlement or refund.
